features.name: Baseline & Verification
features.description: Clean checkout installs and verifies: pnpm install, lint, test (backend+admin), build across backend/admin/public, plus pnpm tc type-check. Docker stack (docker compose up) and Prisma migrate/seed run from clean state.

features.name: User / Auth (backend)
features.description: User accounts, login, AuthGuard + RolesGuard role-based access. Foundation every protected module depends on.
features.evidence: backend SharedModule AuthGuard/RolesGuard; User/Auth module per docs/architecture.md section 2

features.name: PageLayout module (backend)
features.description: Page layout CRUD, publish, schedule, clone. Puck-based layout templates that Posts clone into.

features.name: Post module (backend)
features.description: Post CRUD, clone-into-layout (POST /posts/:id/clone-into-layout injects post into puckData), cron publish (per-minute in-process cron).
features.evidence: backend Post module; clone-into-layout endpoint + cron publish per docs/architecture.md section 3

features.name: Widget / Media / Subscription / Visitor (backend)

features.evidence: backend Widget/Media/Subscription/Visitor modules per docs/architecture.md section 2; db:seed-widgets script

features.name: Redis cache invalidation
features.description: Redis as read-cache via CacheManager + KeyvRedis. On any write, the owning NestJS service clears affected cache keys. Backend stays stateless.
features.evidence: SharedModule CacheManager + KeyvRedis; write-then-clear pattern per docs/architecture.md section 1

features.description: Next.js admin app (workspace 'admin', dir frontend/). Post/layout authoring, Puck editor, media manager. Calls NestJS API. Sentry + Playwright e2e + vitest.

features.name: Multi-tenant data isolation
features.description: Admin sees own drafts + scheduled + all published content; super-admin sees all. List endpoints + detail GETs + ALL mutation endpoints (update, delete, publish, schedule, unpublish, save puck data, widget CRUD, reorder, duplicate, rollback) enforce ownership via assertOwnership helper. Public site uses new /page-layouts/published endpoint for sitemap (was hitting authenticated /page-layouts).
features.evidence: Backend: page-layout/post/media list+detail+mutation endpoints filtered by userId+roleName from JWT. Public sitemap calls /page-layouts/published. 31/31 unit tests pass (added 6 for findAllForAdmin + findByIdForAdmin).

features.name: Admin Management (super-admin only)
features.description: Super-admin-only page at /admin/admins listing all admins (name + email, department, status Active/Offline/Disabled, last login). Stat cards: Total Admins, Active Now (= lastLoginAt within 5 min). Subroute /admin/admins/new with form: avatar (Media picker), first/last name, login email, position, department (select existing or create new inline), default password. POST /auth/create-admin (already SuperAdmin-guarded) + new GET /admins endpoint. Sidebar renames 'Users & Roles' to 'Admin Management' and only renders for SUPER_ADMIN role. Login flow now stamps lastLoginAt. P0 ships without filter / bulk select / sub-role tabs (deferred).
features.evidence: Backend admin module (GET /admins paged + activeNow, PATCH suspend/restore, POST reset-password); class-level @Roles(SuperAdmin). CannotMutateSuperAdmin guard. 9 unit tests (25/25 total). auth.createAdmin extended with avatarUrl + atomic newDepartmentName. login + getProfile touch lastLoginAt. Admin routes /admin/admins + /admin/admins/new with table, stat cards, 3-dot row menu (Reset password modal + Suspend/Restore), avatar via local file upload (10MB client guard) OR Media picker. Sidebar guards 'Admin Management' behind SUPER_ADMIN. Route guard redirects non-super-admin away from /admin/admins.

features.name: Widgets-layout versioning (published + archived) with rollback
features.description: Add version history to PageLayout: persist a snapshot of puckData (+ metadata: title, slug, publishedAt, publishedBy) every time a layout is published or unpublished. Mark prior published version as ARCHIVED/STALE when a new one goes live. Admin UI: version list panel inside widgets-layout editor with status badges (CURRENT / ARCHIVED), preview each version, one-click rollback (clone archived snapshot back to draft or directly republish). Backend: new PageLayoutVersion model (Prisma), endpoints list/get/rollback, cron-aware (scheduled publish must also create a version row). Public site renders only the current published version; archived rows are admin-only.
features.evidence: Prisma migration 20260531033039_add_page_layout_versions; backend page-layout module: listVersions (lazy-backfills v1 when published layout has 0 rows) / getVersion / rollbackVersion (modes: draft / republish); admin route /admin/widgets-layout/[id]/version-history with side-by-side JSON diff modal; 16/16 backend unit tests pass (publish snapshot ordering, rollback slug-conflict-before-mutation, lazy backfill, cron snapshot).

Wrote them into the homepage (trang-chu) Navbar; SiteHeader syndication propagates to all layouts. features.evidence: Scripts in backend/initialScript/migrate-legacy/: build-legacy-header.ts (navbar, idempotent, exports MENU_ITEMS reused by seed-homepage-layout.ts), build-legacy-pages.ts (29 layouts, update-or-create by slug), download-page-media.ts (180/187 assets fetched to uploads/legacy; 2 broken on legacy source), legacy-html.ts (entity decode + img/iframe /uploads->/uploads/legacy rewrite + sanitize), flush-cache.ts (clears NestJS CacheInterceptor keys in Redis namespace hcmus-physics after direct-DB writes). Verified: /vi shows all 9 legacy dropdowns (Playwright screenshot, Dao tao dropdown lists 7 children), EN locale switches labels, all 30 internal nav links resolve to published layouts, gioi-thieu/quy-che-hoc-tap/etc render header+banner+content+footer (cover via resolveMediaUrl loads in dev). tsc --noEmit clean. Note: inline body-image dev 404 is a pre-existing site-wide limitation (body HTML not run through resolveMediaUrl), identical to the 1600 migrated post pages; serves in prod behind the /uploads proxy.

features.name: Admin onboarding tour + Help center
features.description: New teachers get an auto guided tour of the admin tabs on first login (driver.js, Next/Cancel). On finish/cancel it persists per-user (User.tourCompletedAt via PATCH /auth/profile) and collapses to a floating Help button. Help panel has two tabs: Interact (re-runnable interactive walkthroughs that highlight the real buttons — create layout, publish/schedule, create post, upload media — plus replay the tab tour) and Doc (searchable pre-written FAQ). Bilingual VI/EN, VI default.
features.evidence: Backend: User.tourCompletedAt (db push, project convention) + exposed/accepted via UserResSchema/UpdateProfileBodySchema/auth.repo (PATCH /auth/profile). Frontend: driver.js@1.6; lib/tour/{driver.ts,content.ts}; components/admin/{onboarding-tour.tsx,help-center.tsx} mounted in app/admin/layout.tsx; data-tour anchors on sidebar nav + New-layout + create-modal + save menu (save-primary/schedule/publish) + media upload + post-save; sidebar force-expand via tour:sidebar event; driver.js dark theme in globals.css; authApi.completeTour. Verified: admin tsc clean + next build OK; Playwright login → auto-tour highlights Dashboard (VN popover, 1/7), close → Help button + completion toast, Help panel Interact(4 walkthroughs + replay) + Doc(FAQ search), no console errors. driver.js API validated via context7.

features.name: Department-scoped permissions

Enforced in the service layer via department scope helpers; content carries a departmentId FK backfilled from the legacy posts.deptid. Phase 4 (department-prefixed public URLs + landing pages + redirects) is a separate follow-on.
